environment: test-only desktop backend with session secrets; loopback OpenAI-compatible stub on an ephemeral 127.0.0.1 port
flow: import 120 original baseline words and one original study word
seed a same-day Again review so the study word becomes a generation candidate
save article length/target settings and an LLM provider pointing at the loopback stub
generate article, observe job until succeeded, open article and complete the reading session
lookup the target word, receive a validated gloss through the stub, save reading feedback
add the word to review and inspect exported audit tables
asserted: generated body has at least 100 words and article generation succeeds
lookup selects the expected lemma and records generation plus gloss calls
events include article_generate, article_complete, difficulty_feedback and add_to_review
no real endpoint, paid call, private data or system credential store is used
does_not_prove: real model quality, article naturalness or gloss accuracy
UI rendering of this flow or browser storage
human listening, reading comprehension or long-term learning effects
